# openmetadata_test_suite (Data Source)

Looks up a single OpenMetadata test suite by id or fully qualified name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openmetadata_test_suite" "quality_gate" {
  fully_qualified_name = "quality_gate"
}

output "quality_gate_test_suite_id" {
  value = data.openmetadata_test_suite.quality_gate.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Test suite fully qualified name. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.
- `id` (String) Test suite UUID. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.

### Read-Only

- `basic` (Boolean) Whether the server classified this as a basic entity test suite.
- `description` (String) Markdown description.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `executable` (Boolean) Whether the test suite tests an executable entity such as a pipeline.
- `name` (String) Test suite name.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC 3339 format.
- `updated_by` (String) User that performed the last update.
- `version` (Number) Server-side entity version.
